Name: Stock Market Auto-Investor
Description: An independent investment panel with price graphs, asset details, manual trades, and optional automatic investing. Reserve cash as a percentage of cash plus owned share value, set a maximum share price, and choose how purchases are allocated. Auto-Invest uses Core's recorded daily price history without a new collection period. It starts off; disabling it stops all background investment processing. Requires Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0 with its pooled input callback repair. Initial test build.
